question: Which of the following lies between 1 (3)/(5) & 2 (1)/(5) ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert mixed fractions to decimals for quick comparison.

Lower limit: 1 3/5 = 1.60 | Upper limit: 2 1/5 = 2.20

Option (1): 18/11 ≈ 1.636 (Within 1.60 − 2.20)

Option (2): 14/9 ≈ 1.556 | Option (3): 9/4 = 2.25 | Option (4): 14/6 ≈ 2.333

Only 18/11 lies between 1.6 and 2.2.

**∴ The correct answer is 18/11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fraction range: 1 3/5 to 2 1/5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2317e9372d041f50d9570f42524644f652e5e8205456e0c9f541af8dfa31aa1.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Mixed fraction to Improper: a b/c = (a × c + b) / c

**Calculations:**

⇒ Lower Limit = 1 3/5 = (1 × 5 + 3) / 5 = 8/5 = 1.6

⇒ Upper Limit = 2 1/5 = (2 × 5 + 1) / 5 = 11/5 = 2.2

⇒ Option (1): 18 ÷ 11 = 1.6363...

⇒ Option (2): 14 ÷ 9 = 1.5555...

⇒ Option (3): 9 ÷ 4 = 2.25

⇒ Option (4): 14 ÷ 6 = 7 ÷ 3 = 2.3333...

⇒ Comparing 1.6363 with range [1.6, 2.2]: 1.6 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Comparison of Fractions

To compare fractions, either convert them to decimals or find a common denominator. Cross-multiplication (a/b vs c/d → ad vs bc) is also a fast check.

Mixed Fraction Conversion

A mixed fraction a b/c is converted to improper form as (a×c + b)/c and then to decimal by dividing the numerator by the denominator.

Recurring Decimals

Fractions like 18/11 result in repeating decimals (1.6363...). For estimation in range problems, calculating up to 2 or 3 decimal places is usually sufficient.
